IN THE COURT OF THE SESSIONS JUDGE, LUCKNOW

Bail Application No. _____ of 2026

IN THE MATTER OF:
Ramesh Yadav ... Applicant
VERSUS
State of U.P. ... Opposite Party

FIR No. 212/2026, P.S. Hazratganj, Lucknow
Under Section 318(4) BNS

APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 483 OF THE BHARATIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023 FOR GRANT OF REGULAR BAIL

PRAYER

It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to grant regular bail to the applicant, Ramesh Yadav, in FIR No. 212/2026, P.S. Hazratganj, and pass such other order as this Hon'ble Court deems fit.
body:
1. That the applicant Ramesh Yadav has been in judicial custody since 13 September 2026 in connection with FIR No. 212/2026 registered at Police Station Hazratganj, Lucknow under Section 318(4) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

2. That the bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow on 22 September 2026.

3. That the applicant has no criminal antecedents. He is gainfully employed. He has cooperated with the police during investigation.

4. That the applicant has family and social connections in Lucknow.
